_meta: What each release note (R30 to R34) brings. 'cite' = PDF pages; 'terms' checked by tests/verify_citations.py. All [from source].

highlights.text: Goals: performance, concurrency and typing; Ruby 3x3 target (3x faster than Ruby 2.0 on Optcarrot)
MJIT improved, but still not ready for workloads such as Rails
Ractor (experimental): actor-style parallelism, without sharing normal objects
Fiber Scheduler (Fiber#scheduler) to intercept blocking operations
RBS (type language) and TypeProf (generates an RBS prototype)
One-line pattern matching redesigned (=>, in returns a boolean); find pattern; case/in is no longer experimental
Endless method: def square(x) = x * x
Native Hash#except; memory view (experimental C API); IRB 53x faster when pasting code
Keywords separated from positional arguments; ... accepts leading arguments; $SAFE removed
Backtrace order: the 2.5 inversion was reverted
webrick, sdbm, net-telnet and xmlrpc stop being bundled gems or part of the stdlib
YJIT: Shopify's in-process JIT, experimental, --yjit; up to 22% on railsbench and 39% on liquid-render; Unix-like x86-64 only
MJIT: --jit-max-cache from 100 to 10000
debug gem (rewritten debugger) replaces lib/debug.rb
error_highlight (NameError only); enabled by default
IRB with autocomplete and documentation display
Omitted values in Hash and keywords: {x:, y:}
Pin ^ accepts an expression; optional parentheses in one-line pattern matching
RBS: bounded generics, generic aliases, rbs collection; TypeProf for IDE experimental
One-line pattern matching is no longer experimental; evaluation order of multiple assignment changes; Psych 4.0 uses safe_load
net-ftp, net-imap, net-pop, net-smtp, matrix, prime and debug become bundled gems
Initial WebAssembly/WASI support
YJIT is no longer experimental; x86-64 and arm64; building requires Rust 1.58+; 41% faster (yjit-bench); Code GC
ReDoS: matching with memoization (10 s down to 0.003 s; ~90% in linear time)
Global Regexp.timeout and per-regex timeout:; Regexp::TimeoutError
SyntaxSuggest integrated; ErrorHighlight for TypeError and ArgumentError
Anonymous * and ** can be forwarded; no autosplat for procs with keywords; ruby2_keywords mandatory; find pattern stable
MJIT reimplemented in Ruby (fork); Bundler 2.4 with PubGrub
Data (immutable value); Hash#shift; built-in Set; Struct with keywords; Unicode 15.0
Removed Fixnum, Bignum, File.exists?, Dir.exists?, taint and related methods; libyaml/libffi no longer bundled
Prism as a default gem; Lrama in place of Bison
YJIT: speed and memory gains, YJIT.enable at runtime, Code GC off by default
RJIT (JIT in Ruby) replaces MJIT; keep using YJIT in production
M:N thread scheduler
GC improvements (promotion, write barriers, VWA, weak references)
IRB: irb:rdbg, pager, type-based autocomplete
it without arguments deprecated; Regexp.new with at most 2 arguments
ext/readline retired; require warnings for gems that will become bundled
Parameter it
Prism is the default parser; --parser=parse.y for the old one
Happy Eyeballs v2 in TCPSocket.new and Socket.tcp
YJIT: --yjit-mem-size, --yjit-log, methods in Ruby, inlining
Modular GC (RUBY_GC_LIBRARY, experimental MMTk)
Mutating a string literal in a file without frozen_string_literal emits a deprecation warning
**nil accepted; block and keywords in index not allowed; ::Ruby reserved
Ractor: require allowed, Ractor.main?, local storage, store_if_absent
Error/backtrace messages with single quotes and class name; new Hash#inspect
Removed Refinement#refined_class and old Net::HTTP constants; URI with RFC 3986; Timeout.timeout rejects negative values

not_in_notes: Ruby 4.0 and later 3.x fixes (the captures only show them in Recent News)
